description: A substitution \(\sigma\) factors through \(\mu\) if some \(\rho\) satisfies \(\mu(x)[\rho]=\sigma(x)\) for every variable \(x\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Factors.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w} (σ : ℕ → L.Term α)
  (μ : ℕ → L.Term ℕ) : Prop
